messages:
ops-announce: Heads-up: Scheduled maintenance tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC for a rolling runtime config update (quant-runtime v2) + a small controlled failover/loadtest on a subset of Dedicated pools. Expect brief p99 blips; we're bumping SLOs temporarily. See plan below and react if you see anything unexpected. :loudspeaker:

maria: TL;DR: we'll roll config that changes batching/kernel selection heuristics and run a 10min failover at 23:20 in west-1 (10% traffic shift to warm fallback). Goal: validate fallback correctness and cgroup preemption behavior.

alice: Thanks. Which customer tiers are affected? Hosted or Dedicated?

maria: Dedicated first (reserved GPU pools). Hosted unaffected unless admission routed to Dedicated for overflow (unlikely).

ben: Canary will target two small pools (gpu-pool-qa-1, gpu-pool-qa-2). After 30m dry-run we do a 10% divert across a handful of routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat.

carla: Monitoring checklist pls — I'm prepping dashboards and alerts.

maria: Carla: watch per-route p50/p95/p99 latency, RPC error rate, token throughput, and KV cache miss rate. Also watch worker restart/stall counts and GPU memory OOMs. Runbooks: SRE Runbook -> Quant Runtime Rollbacks (link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quant-roll).

dinesh: Rollback criteria? At what threshold do we abort?

maria: Abort if p99 increases > 40% for >5m on canary or error rate spike > 0.5% absolute. Also immediate rollback for repeated OOMs or worker crashes >2/min.

alice: Who's on rotation for the window?

maria: Oncall: alice, ben. Bench: carla for dashboards, dinesh for infra hotfixes. Paging policy unchanged. ops-announce will post updates.

ben: Deploy steps (short):
1) Push config to canary pools: `kubectl apply -f quant-runtime-v2-config.yaml --context=canary`
2) Wait 10m, smoke test with `scripts/quant_smoke.sh`
3) If green, kick 10% divert via routing-controller: `routingctl shift --route=/v1/chat --pool=gpu-pool-qa --percent=10`

deploy-bot: Deployment job queued: quant-runtime-v2-canary (job id: 20260323-07). Notifying owners.

carla: I'll set alert thresholds and a Grafana snapshot in #eng-sre-ops.

maria: Post-failover plan: gather perf diffs, run a short regression on 5 stored prompts, and decide on wider rollout. Aim to finish by 00:30 UTC.

alice: Noted. I'll be online for the 23:20 window. If anything odd, I'll trigger rollback and notify customers in #customer-impact.

ben: One more note: small SLO tweak for tonight only — p99 target bumped to 1.8s (was 1.2s) for routes impacted, to avoid noisy pagers. We'll revert after we confirm fallback behavior. Ops-announce will publish the change in SLO metadata.

maria: Thanks team. If anyone sees unexplained token cost variance or model-quality regressions, flag immediately. See rollout doc: https://redwood.internal/rollouts/quant-runtime-v2 (appendix has rollback commands). Good luck and ping me directly if needed. :pray:
